```{=html}
<style>
.w106-sort { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w106-sort .w106-buckets { display: flex; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; align-items: stretch; }
.w106-sort .w106-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 0; min-height: 170px; padding: 6px 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w106-sort .w106-title { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; color: #d81e2e; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w106-sort .w106-bucket.w106-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w106-sort .w106-pool {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w106-sort .w106-chip {
  display: block; margin: 0; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
  cursor: grab; user-select: none; font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff);
}
.w106-sort .w106-bucket .w106-chip { margin: 6px 0; }
.w106-sort .w106-chip.w106-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w106-sort .w106-chip.w106-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w106-sort .w106-chip.w106-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w106-sort .w106-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w106-sort button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w106-sort .w106-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w106-sort .w106-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w106-sort .w106-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w106-sort .w106-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w106-sort .w106-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="iw w106-sort" id="w106">
  <div class="w106-buckets">
    <div class="w106-bucket" data-cat="mgmt">
      <div class="w106-title">Management plane log</div>
      <div class="w106-slot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w106-bucket" data-cat="svc">
      <div class="w106-title">Service / application log</div>
      <div class="w106-slot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w106-pool" aria-label="items to sort"></div>
  <div class="w106-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w106-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w106-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w106-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w106-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w106-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w106-expl iw-expl" hidden>Management plane logs record control actions - who accessed the infrastructure, what they changed and when - so the Activity Log and a network security group write belong there; service and application logs record the activity of individual services, such as the Nginx access log and the system journal - see <a href="#sec-10-log-sources">the section on log sources</a>.</div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w106');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w106-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w106-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w106-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    ['The Azure Activity Log', 'mgmt'],
    ['The Nginx access log', 'svc'],
    ['Records who accessed the infrastructure, what they changed and when', 'mgmt'],
    ['The system journal (journalctl)', 'svc'],
    ['A network security group write, with caller and result “Succeeded”', 'mgmt'],
    ['Records authentication attempts, API calls, network traffic and errors of one service', 'svc']
  ];
  let picked = null;
  function chipByKey(key) { return root.querySelector('.w106-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]'); }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w106-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w106-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w106-right', 'w106-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w106-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) { bucket.querySelector('.w106-slot').appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  function makeChip(text, cat, key) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w106-chip';
    c.textContent = text;
    c.dataset.cat = cat; c.dataset.key = key;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w106-picked');
      buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w106-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', key));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(b => {
    b.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(b, picked); unpick(); } });
    b.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    b.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault();
      const chip = chipByKey(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
      if (chip) { place(b, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const chip = chipByKey(e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'));
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w106-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w106-right', 'w106-wrong'));
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').forEach(c => {
      if (c.dataset.cat === b.dataset.cat) { c.classList.add('w106-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w106-wrong'); wrong++; }
    }));
    const left = pool.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').length;
    msg.className = 'w106-msg iw-msg';
    if (wrong === 0 && left === 0) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - the two telemetry sources are cleanly separated.';
      msg.classList.add('ok');
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + left + ' item(s) still to sort.';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - ' + wrong + ' item(s) sit in the wrong box (marked red).';
      msg.classList.add('bad');
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w106-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelector('.w106-expl').hidden = true;
    root.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w106-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w106-chip').forEach(c => {
      const b = buckets.find(x => x.dataset.cat === c.dataset.cat);
      b.querySelector('.w106-slot').appendChild(c);
      c.classList.add('w106-right');
    });
    root.querySelector('.w106-expl').hidden = false;
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w106-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it[0], it[1], 'k' + i)));
})();
</script>
```
